title: Letting AI Agents Do My Job
description: Steven talks about his year-long plan to automate his work with round-the-clock AI agents like Claude Code and Cowork, NVIDIA's big gap up after last week's sell-off, and Beijing's spicy tripe-and-vermicelli dish. He also explains the 11 daily supplements he takes and why he started taking them.

sentences.zh: 内容速览
sentences.en: Episode Overview

sentences.zh: 今天这期节目，史蒂文聊了他长达一年的“计划”：让 AI 智能体全天候替他干活，把自己的工作自动化。
sentences.en: In today's episode, Steven talks about his year-long "plan": to have AI agents work for him around the clock and automate his own job.

sentences.zh: 他还聊了英伟达（NVIDIA）上周暴跌后的大幅跳空高开，并终于讲到了那道北京的牛肚菜。
sentences.en: He also talks about NVIDIA's big gap-up open after last week's plunge, and finally gets to that tripe dish from Beijing.

sentences.zh: 最后，他回答了女朋友的问题：他为什么开始吃这么多保健品？
sentences.en: Finally, he answers his girlfriend's question: why has he started taking so many supplements?

sentences.zh: 节目录到一半，烤箱里的牛排和邻居先后来“捣乱”，气氛相当热闹。
sentences.en: Halfway through recording, first the steak in the oven and then a neighbor came along to "cause trouble," making for quite a lively atmosphere.

sentences.zh: 用六个月把工作自动化
sentences.en: Automating His Job in Six Months

sentences.zh: 今年早些时候，史蒂文对开电脑公司的表姐夫说，他要给自己六个月，把工作自动化。
sentences.en: Earlier this year, Steven told his cousin's husband, who runs a computer company, that he would give himself six months to automate his job.

sentences.zh: 结果没成功。
sentences.en: It didn't work out.

sentences.zh: 他不会写代码，还在用老办法：自己搭 WordPress 页面，干等视频渲染。
sentences.en: He couldn't code and was still doing things the old way: building WordPress pages himself and sitting around waiting for videos to render.

sentences.zh: 每一次等待，都会打断他的思路。
sentences.en: Every wait broke his train of thought.

sentences.zh: 后来，终端里的智能体改变了一切。
sentences.en: Then AI agents in the terminal changed everything.

sentences.zh: 他两个月前才开始在终端里用 Claude。
sentences.en: He only started using Claude in the terminal two months ago.

sentences.zh: 用他的话说，AI“让电脑和工作重新变得好玩了”。
sentences.en: In his words, AI "made computers and work fun again."

sentences.zh: ⏰ 全天候的智能体（还得管住嘴）
sentences.en: ⏰ A round-the-clock AI agent (and watching his mouth)

sentences.zh: 他的很多灵感来自 SaaStr 播客：花钱买了智能体却不用，就是浪费钱。
sentences.en: A lot of his inspiration comes from the SaaStr podcast: paying for AI agents and not using them is just wasting money.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文平台订得太多，显然付多了。
sentences.en: Steven has subscribed to too many platforms and is clearly overpaying.

sentences.zh: Claude Cowork 很好用，Codex 他才刚开始“调教”，他还想把更多工作搬到云端，这样就能关掉电脑。
sentences.en: Claude Cowork works really well, and he has only just started "training" Codex; he also wants to move more of his work to the cloud so he can turn off his computer.

sentences.zh: 他的理想是：北京时间下午六点录音，那时多伦多是早上五点。
sentences.en: His ideal is to record at 6 p.m. Beijing time, which is 5 a.m. in Toronto.

sentences.zh: 录完后，流程自动运行，在多伦多早上六七点发布，让家人看到“史蒂文叔叔还在地球另一边好好的”。
sentences.en: Once recorded, the workflow runs automatically and publishes at 6 or 7 a.m. Toronto time, so his family can see that "Uncle Steven is still doing fine on the other side of the world."

sentences.zh: 另外，他最近开始在 Facebook 上直播，昨天不小心爆了一句粗口。
sentences.en: Also, he recently started livestreaming on Facebook, and yesterday he accidentally let slip a swear word.

sentences.zh: 要是妈妈正带着孙辈看直播，那可不太妙，所以他会尽量少说脏话。
sentences.en: If his mom were watching the livestream with her grandkids, that wouldn't be great, so he'll try to swear as little as possible.

sentences.zh: Claude Code 与播客工作流
sentences.en: Claude Code and the podcast workflow

sentences.zh: 半年前他折腾很久的事，Claude 一个下午就搞定了。
sentences.en: Something he struggled with for ages half a year ago, Claude got done in a single afternoon.

sentences.zh: 他甚至用 Claude Code 搭起了完整的网站。
sentences.en: He even used Claude Code to build a complete website.

sentences.zh: 不过要当心 API 密钥和登录信息，谷歌的授权每隔一段时间就会过期。
sentences.en: But you have to be careful with API keys and login details; Google's authorization expires every so often.

sentences.zh: 现在这期播客会带动一整套流程：成语、语法例句、短视频片段，还有各种英语学习版本。
sentences.en: Now this podcast episode drives a whole pipeline: idioms, grammar example sentences, short video clips, and all kinds of English-learning versions.

sentences.zh: 瓶颈在他自己，因为所有内容他都要亲自检查。
sentences.en: He himself is the bottleneck, because he has to check all the content personally.

sentences.zh: AI 剪的空镜头“太糙了，根本没法看”。
sentences.en: The B-roll shots edited by AI are "way too rough, simply unwatchable."

sentences.zh: Claude Cowork 入门
sentences.en: Getting Started with Claude Cowork

sentences.zh: 想学习的话，可以去 YouTube 看 NetworkChuck、Tina Huang 和 Nate Herk。
sentences.en: If you want to learn, check out NetworkChuck, Tina Huang and Nate Herk on YouTube.

sentences.zh: 哪怕你只有一点点副业的念头：
sentences.en: Even if you have only the slightest thought of a side hustle:

sentences.zh: 少去一晚酒吧。
sentences.en: Skip one night at the bar.

sentences.zh: “就选周四晚上，去酒吧的前一天。”
sentences.en: "Just pick Thursday night, the day before you'd go to the bar."

sentences.zh: 花三四个小时看 YouTube，然后装上 Claude Code。
sentences.en: Spend three or four hours watching YouTube, then install Claude Code.

sentences.zh: 付一个月的费用，大约 30 美元。
sentences.en: Pay for one month, about 30 US dollars.

sentences.zh: 他强调自己没有拿赞助。
sentences.en: He stresses that he isn't sponsored.

sentences.zh: 如果只选一个工具，就选 Claude Cowork。
sentences.en: If you only pick one tool, pick Claude Cowork.

sentences.zh: 问它：“你能为我做什么？”
sentences.en: Ask it: "What can you do for me?"

sentences.zh: 让它来“采访”你的爱好和日常。
sentences.en: Let it "interview" you about your hobbies and daily life.

sentences.zh: 别做整理邮箱这类千篇一律的事。
sentences.en: Don't do run-of-the-mill stuff like organizing your inbox.

sentences.zh: 可以做数据看板、深度调研，或者追踪股票。
sentences.en: You could build data dashboards, do deep research, or track stocks.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文呢？
sentences.en: And Steven?

sentences.zh: 他让它把 15 年的旅行视频素材分类，整理进空镜头文件夹。
sentences.en: He had it sort 15 years of travel video footage into B-roll folders.

sentences.zh: 关于隐私：没错，数据会上传到他们的服务器。
sentences.en: About privacy: yes, your data gets uploaded to their servers.

sentences.zh: 但只要你有 Gmail 账号，其实也是同样的取舍。
sentences.en: But if you have a Gmail account, it's really the same trade-off.

sentences.zh: SaaStr 大学与应用维护
sentences.en: SaaStr University and App Maintenance

sentences.zh: 昨天他看了一部分 SaaStr 大学的课程。
sentences.en: Yesterday he watched part of the SaaStr University course.

sentences.zh: 核心问题是：你到底该不该做一个应用？
sentences.en: The core question is: should you build an app or not?

sentences.zh: 因为做出来之后，还得持续维护。
sentences.en: Because once you've built it, you still have to keep maintaining it.

sentences.zh: 官方的说法是，智能体可以替你盯着应用，一两年内多半会实现。
sentences.en: The official line is that agents will be able to watch over your app for you, and that this will most likely happen within a year or two.

sentences.zh: 要是你担心 AI 抢饭碗，不妨想想：没有这份工作，你会做什么？
sentences.en: If you're worried about AI taking your job, ask yourself: without this job, what would you do?

sentences.zh: 史蒂文最近失业过好几次，“你猜我做了什么？我坐下来学 AI。”
sentences.en: Steven has been laid off several times recently. "Guess what I did? I sat down and learned AI."

sentences.zh: 英伟达跳空高开与反弹
sentences.en: Nvidia's gap up and rebound

sentences.zh: 昨天他还担心英伟达会跳空低开，结果却是跳空高开：从周五收盘的 125 美元直接蹿到 165.05 美元，涨幅约 31%。
sentences.en: Yesterday he was still worried Nvidia would gap down, but instead it gapped up: jumping straight from Friday's close of $125 to $165.05, a gain of about 31%.

sentences.zh: “简直离谱。”
sentences.en: "That's just crazy."

sentences.zh: 盘前它已经回落了约 5%，这也在意料之中。
sentences.en: In premarket trading it had already fallen back about 5%, which was also expected.

sentences.zh: 他的判断是：缺口可能会回补到 145 美元附近，但多半不会完全补上。
sentences.en: His take: the gap may fill back to around $145, but most likely won't fill completely.

sentences.zh: 上周的抛售可能就是“恐慌割肉”。
sentences.en: Last week's sell-off was probably just "panic selling at a loss."

sentences.zh: 他认为股价会在 160 到 170 美元之间徘徊一阵，仍然预期会出现 V 型反转。
sentences.en: He thinks the stock will hover between $160 and $170 for a while, and he still expects a V-shaped reversal.

sentences.zh: 以上不构成投资建议。
sentences.en: The above is not investment advice.

sentences.zh: 要是拿不准：“落袋为安，永远不会亏。”
sentences.en: If you're unsure: "Taking profits never loses you money."

sentences.zh: 那道北京牛肚菜
sentences.en: That Beijing beef tripe dish

sentences.zh: 这道菜叫京味爆肚粉：“京”是北京，“味”是味道，“爆肚”是快速焯熟的牛肚，“粉”是粉丝。
sentences.en: The dish is called jingwei baodu fen: "jing" means Beijing, "wei" means flavor, "baodu" is beef tripe that's been quickly blanched, and "fen" is glass noodles.

sentences.zh: 他们点的是辣的，放了很多辣椒。
sentences.en: They ordered the spicy version, with lots of chili peppers.

sentences.zh: 牛肚看起来毛茸茸的，一煮就像鱿鱼圈那样卷起来，但它和粉丝、蒜、洋葱、麻酱拌在一起，所以“想起来比吃起来更让人发怵”。
sentences.en: The tripe looks fuzzy and curls up like calamari rings as soon as it's cooked, but it's mixed with glass noodles, garlic, onion and sesame paste, so it's "more intimidating to think about than to eat."

sentences.zh: 胶原蛋白、保健品，以及他为什么吃
sentences.en: Collagen, supplements, and why he takes them

sentences.zh: 出发去菜市口之前，他请女朋友帮忙在中国找胶原蛋白肽。
sentences.en: Before leaving for Caishikou, he asked his girlfriend to help him find collagen peptides in China.

sentences.zh: 在加拿大，大约 300 克要花 33 到 40 美元。
sentences.en: In Canada, about 300 grams costs 33 to 40 dollars.

sentences.zh: 他把它和肌酸一起加进早晨的咖啡里，觉得恢复得更好。
sentences.en: He adds it to his morning coffee along with creatine and feels he recovers better.

sentences.zh: 中国的食品安全确实让人担心，不过这里很容易买到胶原蛋白和蛋白粉。
sentences.en: Food safety in China is genuinely worrying, but collagen and protein powder are easy to buy here.

sentences.zh: 鱼油、南非醉茄和肌酸，他还是从国外带进来。
sentences.en: Fish oil, ashwagandha and creatine he still brings in from abroad.

sentences.zh: 他每天一共吃大约 11 种：胶原蛋白、鱼油、南非醉茄、锌、镁、水飞蓟、泛醇、MCT 油、玛卡、肌酸，偶尔还有高丽参。
sentences.en: Altogether he takes about 11 a day: collagen, fish oil, ashwagandha, zinc, magnesium, milk thistle, ubiquinol, MCT oil, maca, creatine, and occasionally Korean ginseng.

sentences.zh: 他停掉了假马齿苋，因为伤胃；也不碰银杏，因为它与中风有关，而他家里有这方面的病史。
sentences.en: He stopped taking bacopa because it upset his stomach; he also stays away from ginkgo because it's linked to strokes, and his family has a history of them.

sentences.zh: 那他为什么开始吃？
sentences.en: So why did he start taking them?

sentences.zh: 几年前，他意识到自己留在中国的时间可能有限。
sentences.en: A few years ago, he realized his time in China might be limited.

sentences.zh: “要么去台湾、韩国、日本，要么回加拿大去仓库搬箱子。”
sentences.en: "Either go to Taiwan, Korea or Japan, or go back to Canada and move boxes in a warehouse."

sentences.zh: 于是他开始做副业，少喝酒，还想通过“生物黑客”提升大脑，来学普通话和俄语。
sentences.en: So he started a side business, drank less, and wanted to boost his brain through "biohacking" to learn Mandarin and Russian.

sentences.zh: 鱼油缓解了脑雾，南非醉茄帮他对付焦虑，锌则让他 30 分钟内就犯困。
sentences.en: Fish oil eased his brain fog, ashwagandha helped him deal with anxiety, and zinc makes him sleepy within 30 minutes.

sentences.zh: 他推荐的入门前三名是鱼油、锌和南非醉茄。
sentences.en: His top three recommendations for beginners are fish oil, zinc and ashwagandha.

sentences.zh: 不过，这不是健康建议，请先咨询医生。
sentences.en: That said, this isn't medical advice; please consult a doctor first.

sentences.zh: 今日总结
sentences.en: Today's Summary

sentences.zh: 不管是 AI 智能体、股票还是保健品，都要自己做功课，亲自试一试，看看什么才真正适合你。
sentences.en: Whether it's AI agents, stocks or supplements, you have to do your own homework and try things out yourself to see what really suits you.

sentences.zh: 要是拿不准，就先落袋为安，见好就收。
sentences.en: If you're not sure, lock in your gains first and quit while you're ahead.

vocab.en: to gap up at the open (stock market)
to take profits and be safe
